message: With me as the Umpire, the two face off at the outdoor training grounds.
The flames of their anger were practically visible; even just standing between them, the sheer pressure was palpable.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Prepare yourself. I’m not holding back.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Are you sure you want to say that？ You won't have any excuses when you lose.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...I'll beat you. I'll crush you.」
Ririmu, letting her anger show, and Asahi, who remained at least outwardly calm. Even at a time like this, the two were polar opposites.

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, wait. Before you both start, I want you to make a promise.」
Both were too intent on glaring at each other to reply, but since they seemed to be listening, I continued.

name: Iori
message: 「When the match is over, whoever wins, you both shake hands and make up. Deal？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh！？ What are you talking about？ Come on, we're not kids, give me a break.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I cannot accept that, even if it is your suggestion, Iori-sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「If you can't agree to that, the match doesn't start. And of course, I won't permit any private feuding, either.」
When I made the declaration, they both seemed taken aback, though they looked incredibly dissatisfied.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Sensei, isn't that <d0071>abuse of power</d>？」

name: Iori
message: 「I proposed this practice match as a way for you two to understand each other better. That’s exactly why I can't back down on this.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Understood. Since you've gone that far, I have no choice.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I suppose I can bring myself to show mercy to Ririmu-san once she’s begging for forgiveness while crying on the ground. It is, after all, a winner's duty.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, I’m winning anyway, right？ Maybe after I crush you, it’ll actually feel pretty good.」
Trading barbs, the two start throwing sparks again.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright. Then you're both in agreement on the promise. Are you ready—well, no point in even asking.」
I raised my hand slightly to signal, gave the two a fleeting look, and...

name: Iori
message: 「Then... start！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I'll crush you！」
As soon as the signal was given, Ririmu bolted.
She rushed straight toward Asahi, who already had her Iai stance set.
Keeping her posture low, she moved with considerable speed. Very fast, but...

name: Asahi
message: 「With that much...！！」
Before I could even think, "This is dangerous," the moment Ririmu entered her Iai drawing range, Asahi struck in a flash without hesitation.
A silver light glimmered, tracing a beautiful semicircle...
However, Ririmu had vanished from that trajectory.

name: Ririmu
message: 「That’s my line！」
Ririmu was in mid-air.
She had gone out of her way to approach with a low posture, likely to bait an attack on her lower half before leaping up to evade it.
Carrying her momentum, Ririmu slid through the air and closed in on Asahi—

name: Ririmu
message: 「Gotcha！」
Asahi barely managed to block Ririmu’s blow—reminiscent of a helmet-splitter—by using her sheath.
While this is a standard defensive measure in Iai, being forced to use it from the opening move wasn't exactly a good sign.
Meanwhile, Ririmu wore a smug expression as she flew over Asahi’s head and landed behind her.
She spun around immediately, pressing the attack to ensure Asahi had no time to reset her stance.

name: Ririmu
message: 「I'm gonna crush you in an instant！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Getting carried away...！」
Constantly circling to Asahi's right side to prevent her from sheathing her blade, Ririmu launched a barrage of quick strikes, giving her no room to breathe.

name: Iori
message: （Is this... the result of all the special training, I wonder?）
Ririmu had spent time training against past Toujinegi using Yorishiro-kun.
And among them was Asahi’s brother, Kuki Takahisa.
She had fought against Takahisa, who like Asahi uses Iai-battou, countless times. Ririmu's current fighting style was likely a countermeasure cultivated through that experience.

name: Asahi
message: 「Haa！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Too slow！」
Deflecting Asahi’s attempt to push back, Ririmu kept up the assault.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Your style is just a carbon copy of your brother's！ I know all your moves！」
Ririmu stepped in even further, cutting off Asahi as she tried to leap back—

name: Ririmu
message: 「I'm not letting you escape！」
Trying to run is pointless. More than that, I won't even give her the chance to find an opening to run.
I'll keep changing the rhythm and keep pressing the attack！

name: Ririmu
message: （I've already figured out how to counter a Kijo's Iai-battou, so I can totally do this even without the illusions！）

name: Ririmu
message: 「How's this, how's this, how's this！」
Asahi was entirely on the defensive. She was just desperately parrying my attacks, barely able to mount any counter-offensive at all.
I really am overwhelmingly stronger！ I'll push through like this and empty her Barrier Jacket in no time—
I thought I could win right away like this, but... something's wrong.
Even if I'm as strong as they say, I feel like something is off.

name: Ririmu
message: （I mean... wait？ Isn't Asahi's Barrier Jacket completely unscratched！？）

name: Asahi
message: 「Next, there...！」
Parried again. My attacks still aren't landing.
Asahi is purely on the defensive. That's a given. Because I'm the only one attacking, and Asahi hasn't counterattacked once.
But I've been on the offensive this whole time, and Asahi hasn't taken a single direct hit from me yet...！

name: Ririmu
message: （Why！？ It was nothing like this when I fought her brother！）

name: Ririmu
message: 「Take this...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「No matter how many times you throw such attacks at me...！」
Deflected by Asahi's blade, I'm finally forced to jump back.
That wasn't an attack. It was absolutely meant solely to push me back.

name: Ririmu
message: （Damn it, back to square one！）
While I regain my stance, Asahi is resetting her own guard as well.
Well, I guess it's better that I wasn't attacked during that time. When I fought her brother, there were times when he'd press the attack from there and I'd lose, but—

name: Asahi
message: 「Are you done already？ That was a weak attack.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Getting cocky just because you blocked that? You really are small-fry, huh?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Can you only manage attacks that even small-fry can block? In that case, you are the square of a small-fry.」
She's provoking me. But Asahi just waits right there—

name: Ririmu
message: （...I see, so that's how it is.）
I get it now—she's the opposite of her brother.
He used Iai and kept attacking relentlessly, so if I pressed the attack against him, I could actually take him down quite easily.
But Asahi is the opposite. It’s an easy win if she attacks, but when she goes on the defensive like this, she becomes incredibly solid.

name: Ririmu
message: （Seriously, she’s way too sturdy...！）

name: Ririmu
message: 「But... I can't win if I don't attack！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Heh, you're naive...！」
Even when I unleash a flurry of blows, hitting from the right, left, above, and below, she just blocks and deflects them all.
Now that she’s started defending, Asahi is even using her Iai skills for defense.
The trajectory of her sword, her aim, the swing of her arms—everything is meant to block my attacks. Thanks to that, I’m being thoroughly pushed back.
No matter how much I change the rhythm of my attacks, it's no use. Asahi won't let her pace be broken.

name: Ririmu
message: （Come to think of it, Momitchi said it too... that Asahi is a real pain once she commits to defense）

name: Ririmu
message: （Geez, she’s just so hard to deal with...！）
Besides, Asahi’s stamina is overwhelmingly superior―I have to admit that much. I mean, she spent twenty minutes trading blows with Vicky―senpai, after all.
In other words, I have to take her down before I run out of steam！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well then, I guess... there’s really nothing else for it！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「World is Mine—」

name: Asahi
message: 「This is...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I didn’t really want to use this, but what can you do, right？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Will this make your attacks, which are no better than those of a small fry, even slightly more tolerable?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmph, you’re the small fry here, so I doubt you’ll be able to block it！」

name: Asahi
message: （Here it comes...！）
Ririmu-san charges straight at me again. But this is likely an illusion.
Ririmu-san’s Tenju specialty is showing her opponent hallucinations. She cloaks the truth in phantoms visible only to her adversary.

name: Asahi
message: （What a distasteful technique...！）
This is the third time this match I’ve experienced her illusions. Although I’ve thought of countermeasures, they aren’t foolproof.

name: Asahi
message: （Left... no, right！？）
The moment I think Ririmu-san, who dove in, has readied herself on the left, I see a blade at the edge of my vision and instinctively slash at it！

name: Asahi
message: （Tch, no impact...！）

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wrong side！」
I twist my body in a panic to dodge the attack from Ririmu-san, who appeared from the complete opposite side, but the tip of her blade grazed my Barrier Jacket.
This much isn't a problem, but—

name: Ririmu
message: 「Keep it going, keep it going！」
Perhaps sensing my momentary hesitation, Ririmu-san gets carried away and presses the assault.
Of course, I manage to parry everything from the second strike onward, but attacks woven with these illusions are truly troublesome and vicious.

name: Asahi
message: （Even if I’ve seen them before, this is how it goes... I doubt I could parry them entirely on the first encounter）
I cannot help but acknowledge this peculiarity, this surprise factor, and the sheer talent required to create it.
However—

name: Asahi
message: 「If I know it’s an illusion, I can handle it！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Then why don't you try handling it！」
Ririmu―san, who had been right in front of me, crouched down and vanished from my field of vision―or so I thought, before she appeared on my right side.
However, I completely ignored it.
Leaving only a presence behind, the blade passed through me and vanished like smoke.
I ignore these baffling attacks that lie outside the scope of my predictions.
If my read is correct, the real one is somewhere else. And—at this timing！

name: Asahi
message: 「There！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Something like that, no problem！」
When I parried the real attack coming from the left, Ririmu-san seemed surprised.
Even so, she immediately launched another attack.
This time a blade appeared as if to strike diagonally—but I ignored it. Instead, I held my scabbard upright near my torso to use as a shield.
Next, another one. The blades that appeared were at my right mid-section and left upper-section. However, I intuitively twisted my body and struck out behind me.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Kyaa！？ Wait... seriously, you can deal with that！？」
Though light, there was feedback this time.
And that wasn't just the satisfaction of a hit; it was also the satisfaction of knowing my countermeasure worked.

name: Asahi
message: （The phantoms are certainly troublesome, but it seems their 'manifestation' is bound to be unnatural after all.）
If you don't waver, don't get misled, and deal with it calmly, it's entirely possible to discern the unnaturalness.
If you fully trust your eyes and your intuition, you can eventually find the point where the real attack occurs.

name: Asahi
message: （Is Ririmu―san aware of this, or even if she is, is she unable to do anything about it―）
Either way, I can win like this.
She said she had a countermeasure for me. But if we're talking about countermeasures, I have the upper hand—！

name: Ririmu
message: 「That was just a total fluke！」

name: Asahi
message: 「In that case, I shall show you as many times as you like！」
Asahi kept on parrying Ririmu’s sword strikes, which were mixed with phantoms. No matter how much she was shaken, she never wavered from her form.
Truly, as immovable as a mountain, as swift as thunder—
Conversely, Ririmu was moving around thoroughly and frantically, continuing to strike in an attempt to dismantle Asahi’s stronghold.
Her free-spirited and unpredictable blade was the complete opposite of Asahi's in every way.

name: Ririmu
message: 「My world！ There's no way it could be stopped by a knock-off like you！」

name: Asahi
message: 「That attitude... that is exactly what I find displeasing！」
I deflected the sword I’d parried from Ririmu with great force. At the same time, this time it was Asahi who stepped in.

name: Asahi
message: 「Acting as though you're the only one who's special！ The sheer selfishness of a narrow view that sees nothing but your own circumstances！ Not even sparing a thought for the other side—」

name: Asahi
message: 「It's that attitude of treating yourself as absolute！」
Ririmu caught the blade.
Asahi mustered all her strength and knocked Ririmu back, guard and all.

name: Asahi
message: 「'Why can't you understand when I'm right? Every opinion different from mine is wrong. Because I'm the one who's right.' That's what you want to say, isn't it?」
Asahi took her stance again. Snorting with anger.

name: Asahi
message: 「You're just like a child throwing a tantrum. There is no basis for you being right.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Forcing the right answer you made up yourself onto others is the very height of arrogance！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Every single bit of that is about you！」
Ririmu dashed forward and unleashed a strike.
Asahi blocked it, but by then, Ririmu was already slashing in from another direction.

name: Ririmu
message: 「You're the narrow-minded one who can't see anything except Sensei！ You've got some nerve talking when you treat Sensei as absolute！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I don't think I'm special or anything！ I just want to decide my own business for myself！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You can do whatever you want, and Sensei can do the same！ Everyone else can just do whatever they feel like！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So I'm gonna do things the way I want, too！ I won't let anyone get in my way—it's as simple as that！ How can you not get such basic logic？！」
A wild, swinging strike, as if trying to slam it down.
It was a rhythm of attack unlike anything Ririmu had shown before, yet Asahi answered it with sheer force and caught the blow.

name: Ririmu
message: 「I couldn't care less about other people's circumstances！ They can do whatever they want and go die on their own for all I care！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It's the same for me！ That's why I can't stand having what I'm doing stopped because of somebody else！」
Ririmu swung her blade to attack, and Asahi swung hers to defend, knocking it aside.

name: Asahi
message: 「Then you ought to just live all by yourself！ The academy is a place to seek instruction from those who came before you！」

name: Asahi
message: 「If you wish to be self-contained, then leave the academy at once, go wherever you please, and die on your own！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I paid out of my own pocket to get into this academy！ Providing service worth that price is the academy's obligation, isn't it！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So what if I am?! What’s so wrong with that!」
Their blades clash and grind against each other.

name: Asahi
message: 「You’re doing it again—refusing to accept anything that doesn’t meet your own standards！ Acting so arrogant, just screaming for everyone to fall in line with you！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That’s just ‘cause you’re so low-class！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Besides, even if I did have a problem, I don't need you nagging me about it！」
The two pushed off each other and leaped a great distance apart.

name: Ririmu
message: 「I’m seriously pissed off now… I’m not gonna forgive you.」
As she glared at Asahi, who was bracing herself again—Ririmu’s presence shifted once more.

name: Ririmu
message: （I didn’t intend on showing this much at first, but—）
But it couldn't be helped. She was the one person I had to take down, no matter what. I’ll beat her. I’ll crush her. I’ll smash her with everything I’ve got！

name: Ririmu
message: 「I’m gonna make you regret getting me this seriously angry！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ugh, this is…」
The world changes. It’s becoming my world. Becoming more and more dyed in my colors—！

name: Ririmu
message: 「First time seeing this, right！」

name: Asahi
message: 「You can see things like this as much as you want with Holographic Reality, you know.」

name: Asahi
message: 「To go out of your way to recreate it with Tenju… what a tedious effort…！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ha, keep talking. You’ll figure out real quick that it’s something totally different！」
This is my world. My own worldview. So everything here goes exactly as I please—！

name: Asahi
message: 「Ugh…！ Suddenly, the ground…！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Just crawling on the ground isn’t gonna be enough for you！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You’re gonna fall way, way down to the bottom of the earth！」
The ground beneath Asahi’s feet crumbled, opening up into a hole.
And just like that, she kept falling, down and down into the depths of the earth—
Naturally, it was an illusion. So I dashed right into the middle of it.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Take that！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Aghhh…！！」
A blow to the stomach of the off-balance Asahi！
She had been sturdy until just now, but this definitely left her guard wide open.

name: Asahi
message: 「Against such a mere illusion...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「And yet, that illusion is exactly what's beating you！」
As I pressed the attack, Asahi barely managed to put up a defense.
Still, it wasn't the solid defense she’d had before. It was just a desperate scrape.
No matter how much she knows it’s an illusion, she’s already been mastered by the sensation of falling that my world conjures.
Because of that, her footing is unsteady and her strikes lack follow-through.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Iai without a stable stance is no better than a scarecrow！ You’re not just refusing to move; you can't move at all！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Don't get cocky...！！」
Trying desperately to pull herself together, Asahi seemed to force strength into her falling legs and turned to counterattack.
But—

name: Asahi
message: 「Haa！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Like that’s ever gonna hit me！」
Her step was weak, her swing was slow, and it lacked any real impact. That was easy to dodge.
Besides, she’s brittle enough as it is whenever she shifts to offense.
I’ll rain down a barrage of counterattacks and knock her flat！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Take that! And that!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I already told you, I’ve already got your swordsmanship countered thanks to your brother！ And I beat him into the ground too, didn't I！」

name: Asahi
message: 「You... again...！」
Another useless attack flew at me. I dodged it easily and followed up with another counter.

name: Asahi
message: 「Ugh, uuu...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahaha！ See, I’m clearly the stronger one after all！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I’m not afraid of the Kuki name！ Your brother was that pathetic too, so why don't you both just bow down before me！」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Enough... already...！」
I thought I’d land one more—but suddenly, Asahi planted her feet and caught my strike.

name: Asahi
message: 「That’s quite enough, Tobe Ririmu...！！！」
Asahi entangled our blades, pulled me in, and swung to strike at my midsection. But Ririmu dodged it by a hair's breadth.

name: Asahi
message: 「You’ll never be forgiven？ That’s my line.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ha! Who ever said I wanted forgiveness from the likes of you？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Silence—no, I will silence you myself.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I won’t forgive you... the one thing I will never forgive is your mockery of my brother！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？ You're snapping at me just because someone talked smack about your brother？ I don't get that at all.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Shut your mouth！ You don't know anything at all...！！」

name: Asahi
message: 「You don't know why my brother became a Toujinegi, or what happened afterward, or anything... anything at all...！！」
Consumed by anger, Asahi closes the distance to Ririmu.

name: Asahi
message: 「I saw every bit of his effort and his struggle leading up to him becoming a Toujinegi right before my eyes.」

name: Asahi
message: 「And I heard every word when he talked about his dreams for the future.」

name: Asahi
message: 「But after he became a Toujinegi, he got injured... and that was the end of it all...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「His dreams, everything—he was forced to give it all up！」

name: Asahi
message: 「And yet, he always smiled like it was nothing, pushing himself just so he wouldn't make me worry...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I couldn't do anything...！ Do you have any idea how agonizing that is for me！」

name: Asahi
message: 「My resolve is different from yours—someone who's lived as she pleased, drifting like a weed without ever knowing real hardship！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That's... you don't know a thing！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Do you seriously think I've just been living a carefree life！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I've been forced into elite schools since I was little, I've had to do exactly as my parents say, they even decided who I was going to marry...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Even Jindou, the one thing I finally found that I loved, they tried to take that away from me too！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You really think there was no hardship in a life like that！？ Don't you dare mess with me！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You have no idea how painful it is—not being able to decide a single thing about your own future！」
The sword fight between the two had become something ghastly to behold even from the sidelines.
Not only me, but even Momiji and Setsugekka didn't say a single word.
Asahi and Ririmu were both pouring their hearts out, unleashing strikes laden with all of their raw emotions.

name: Asahi
message: 「Haaaaaaaahhhhhhh！！！」
The clash of swords, their battle cries, and the sound of Barrier Jackets wearing down all mingled together.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Raaaaaaaahhhhhhh！！！」
The damage had accumulated to the point where it wouldn't be strange if either one of them collapsed at any moment.
Yet there were no cries of pain or shock. To defeat the other―with that single―minded resolve, they swung their blades.

name: Asahi
message: 「You！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'm the one！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I'm the one！」

name: Asahi & Ririmu
message: 「Who's going to take you down for good！！」
Both within lethal range—
They stepped in at the exact same instant. And swung their swords as one.
No defense. Just bring the other down. Pouring everything into that alone—

name: Asahi
message: 「Fall, you arrogant girl！！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Get crushed, you Kijooo！！！」
The two blades crossed, and a thunderous shockwave roared out.
Both of them froze at the end of their swings... and before long, neither quite before the other, they dropped to their knees.
Neither of them had enough Tenju left to keep fighting.
